The watermill turns in the background and light moves softly through leaves. Keep the tower face blank. No one looks at the camera and no character appears suddenly.

shots.scene: 0–2s: Jihoon releases the already-open door and crosses the threshold, with Doto close beside him and Ipsae flying ahead. 2–6s: they walk into the room toward the workbench, taking visible, natural steps. 6–8s: Jihoon reaches the workbench and turns his attention to the two pots while Ipsae hovers by them and Doto arrives at his feet. Sunlight through the glass dome reveals jars, growing plants and observation tools. No instant plant growth, no magical experiment result and no additional props appear.

shots.title: 발견을 품고 밖으로
shots.scene: 0–3s: Jihoon walks toward the doorway with his completed green field book and rolled certificate securely carried as shown; Ipsae leads and Doto follows at his side. 3–7s: the group crosses the threshold into golden afternoon light, with several clear steps and natural backpack movement. 7–10s: they follow the village lane toward the bridge. The restored clock has its glowing leaf hand, water flows and the garden moves in the breeze. The seedling left inside remains rooted in its pot. Their pride is expressed by purposeful relaxed movement, never by presenting a certificate to the camera.

shots.title: 마을 밖 더 넓은 세계
shots.scene: 0–3s: Jihoon, Ipsae and Doto continue away along the winding meadow path, taking natural visible steps; nobody turns around. 3–7s: as the camera rises, the familiar village becomes one part of a much larger living world: fields, orchards, flowing rivers and distant homes. 7–10s: the group advances farther along the path, small against the vast landscape, while clouds drift gently and a few distant birds cross the sky. A soft warm glimmer gradually flows across the existing distant clock face. At this wide distance its hand does not need to be distinguishable; do not invent a new hand, change the face geometry or enlarge the clock. Preserve Jihoon's green book, backpack and secured rolled certificate. The mood is an open-ended discovery journey, not a victory poster.
